blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.
blocks.zh: 基因传播模型非常适合概率降水即时播报,但现有方法往往依赖于经过单独训练的压缩或确定性预测组件,而且由于迭代去诺,推论成本仍然很高。 我们引入了Just Weather Scoring(JWS),这是一个单阶段,端到端的传播模型,它通过直接在雷达空间进行预测和使几步生成得以解决这两个问题. 雷达空间模型大大简化了培训和推论,并消除了因压缩损失而产生的不确定性。 JWS 组合假面同步 散射(英語:difusion),是一种保存清洁上下文同时将扩散训练适应高维时空数据的时步抽样方案,其简单的评分规则目标将训练与概率预测相配合,解锁几步生成. 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上,JWS以较低的培训和推论成本实现最新概率预测性能. 甚至我们最小的模型仍然具有竞争力,使用的参数少得多,17x以上的推论更快.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Short-term, high-resolution precipitation nowcasting is essential for applications ranging from renewable energy planning ( Sperati et al., 2016 ; Wu et al., 2018 ) to emergency response ( Salio et al., 2025 ) .
Useful nowcasts must resolve spatial details, update rapidly, and quantify uncertainty arising from chaotic dynamics and limited observability ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ) .
Compared to numerical weather prediction, machine learning offers faster inference and learns directly from data.
Yet, regression averages plausible forecasts and thus produces increasingly blurry forecasts as uncertainty grows.
Generative models instead sample plausible precipitation from the conditional distribution, enabling sharp individual forecasts and ensemble-based uncertainty quantification.
Reliable probabilistic forecasting requires representing the full range of possibilities rather than concentrating on a few outcomes. Therefore, diffusion models are a natural fit due to their distributional coverage.
blocks.zh:
短期高分辨率降水即时播报对于从可再生能源规划(Sperati等,2016年;Wu等,2018年)到应急响应(Salio等,2025年)的应用至关重要.
有用的即时播报必须解决空间细节,迅速更新,并量化混乱动态和有限的可观察性所产生的不确定性(Ravuri等,2021年).
相较于数值天气预测,机器学习提供了更快的推论并直接从数据中学习.
然而,回归的平均值是可信的预测,因此,随着不确定性的增加,预测会越来越模糊。
基因模型取而代之的是有条件分布的可信降水,从而能够作出尖锐的个别预测和基于共同的不确定性量化。
可靠的概率预测需要代表各种可能性,而不是集中于一些结果。 因此,传播模型由于其分布范围而自然适合。

blocks.en:
However, many diffusion-based nowcasting approaches rely on multi-stage training pipelines.
Inspired by image generation ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , latent space methods first train a compression model and learn denoising of forecasts only on compressed representations to reduce cost ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Leinonen et al., 2023 ) .
Other approaches use a deterministic forecast to condition generation ( Gong et al., 2024 ) or define a residual prediction task ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , resulting in up to three components.
Beyond training complexity, these components introduce uncertainty and biases.
While visually minor imperfections are acceptable in image synthesis, small errors in precipitation intensity and location can have a consequential impact.
FREUD ( Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) partially addresses this concern by modeling uncertainty from lossy compression with a generative decoder.
Nevertheless, it retains a separate compression stage, and quantification of compression uncertainty requires ensembling many reconstructions per forecast, leading to multiplicative cost.
blocks.zh:
然而,许多基于传播的即时播报办法依赖多阶段培训管道。
在图像生成的启发下(Rombach等,2022年),潜在空间方法首先训练出压缩模型并只学习去诺预测压缩表示来降低成本(Gao等,2023年;Leinonen等,2023年).
其他方法使用定型预测来进行条件生成(Gong等,2024年)或定义剩余预测任务(Yu等,2024年),结果最多可分出三个部分.
除了培训的复杂性外,这些组成部分还带来不确定性和偏见。
虽然视觉上微小的不完美在图像合成中是可以接受的,但降水强度和位置上的小错误可能会有相应的影响.
FREUD(Shusterbauer等,2026b.)通过用基因解码器模拟失落压缩产生的不确定性,部分解决了这一关切.
尽管如此,它还是保留了单独的压缩阶段,压缩不确定性的量化需要每次预测大量重建,从而导致多重成本.

blocks.en:
Therefore, prior work leaves the central challenge unresolved: how to build a simple, uncertainty-aware nowcasting model that makes efficient use of training and inference compute.
We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), an end-to-end generative model that avoids additional stages and operates directly on uncompressed data.
We enable forecasting with a single transformer that is parametrized to predict clean radar maps ( Li & He, 2025 ) and downsamples only by patchification. Our single-stage approach is more efficient and capable than pipelines with multiple trained components.
Further, we introduce Masked Asynchronous Diffusion (MAD), preserving clean conditioning while sampling correlated, framewise noise levels for predicted timesteps, aligning training with forecasting.
Thus, by training with MAD, JWS supports flexible conditioning.
Spatiotemporal resolution-aware timestep sampling in MAD adapts corruption levels to uncompressed radar data.
blocks.zh:
因此,以前的工作使核心挑战得不到解决:如何建立一个简单、意识到不确定性的现成模式,以有效利用培训和推论计算。
我们引入了Just Weather Scoring(JWS),这是一种从端到端的基因模型,它避免了额外的阶段并直接在未压缩的数据上运行.
我们使用一个单一的变压器进行预测,这种变压器可以对干净的雷达地图(Li & He,2025年)和下取样进行预测,但只能通过补丁。 我们的单阶段办法比有多种训练有素部件的管道更有效、更能发挥作用。
此外,我们引入了 " 蒙面同步扩散 " (MAD),在采样相关的同时保持清洁的调节,为预测的时序设置框架噪声水平,使培训与预测相一致。
因此,通过MAD培训,JWS支持灵活调节.
Spatiotemporal分辨率-意识到时间步骤在MAD中的采样使腐败程度适应了未压缩的雷达数据.

blocks.en:
As iterative denoising remains costly, we aim to reduce sampling steps.
Flow Map methods ( Boffi et al., 2025a ) reduce denoising steps by directly learning the integration over diffusion time. However, canonical approaches ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Frans et al., 2025 ; Boffi et al., 2025b ) incur substantial overhead to construct training targets.
Functional Generative Networks (FGNs) ( Alet et al., 2025 ) use scoring-rule supervision to directly optimize probabilistic forecasts but introduce stochasticity only by noise injection into deterministic predictors, potentially limiting distributional coverage.
blocks.zh:
由于迭接点名费仍然很高,我们的目标是减少取样步骤。
Flow Map方法(Boffi等,2025年a)通过在传播过程中直接学习集成,来减少取名步骤. 然而,采取犬类方法(Geng等人,2025年;Frans等人,2025年;Boffi等人,2025年b)在建立培训目标方面需要大量间接费用。
功能基因网络(FGNs)(Alet等,2025年)使用打分规则监督直接优化概率预测,但仅通过向定点预测器中注入噪声来引入分色,可能限制分布范围.

blocks.en:
We seek to combine scoring-rule supervision with diffusion model coverage.
Distributional Diffusion Models (DDM) ( De Bortoli et al., 2025 ) replace vector field regression with scoring-rule supervision, training denoising models to represent the conditional posterior through ensembles of vector fields.
With a conditional posterior, reverse transitions recover the data distribution even on a coarse time grid, enabling few-step inference ( De Bortoli et al., 2025 ) .
However, balancing few- and many-step generation previously required careful tuning of interdependent variables.
We propose simple Distributional Diffusion Models (sDDM), which are trained with a hyperparameter-free objective, linearly interpolating distributional CRPS and squared error.
blocks.zh:
我们力求将评分规则监督与传播模式覆盖相结合。
分布式扩散模型(DDM)(De Bortoli等,2025年)用打分规则监督取代向量场回归,培训去诺模型,以通过向量场的组合来代表有条件后期.
有了有条件的后退,反向过渡甚至可以在粗糙的时间网格上恢复数据分布,从而可以进行几步推论(De Bortoli等,2025年)。
然而,平衡少数和多个步骤的一代以前需要认真调整相互依存的变量。
我们提出简单的分布式扩散模型(sDDM),这些模型以超参数无目标训练,线性地插入分布式CRPS和平方错误.

blocks.en:
With MAD and sDDM, JWS generates radar sequences directly in pixel space, eliminating additional pipeline stages and allocating computation entirely to generative forecasting.
Our key insight is that standard transformers can support efficient end-to-end nowcasting by combining task-specific timestep sampling with distributional supervision.
This yields simple and efficient training and inference with superior probabilistic forecasting, without lossy compression or deterministic priors.
blocks.zh:
通过MAD和SDDM,JWS在像素空间直接生成雷达序列,消除了额外的管相并完全将计算分配给基因预测.
我们的主要见解是,标准变压器可以支持高效的端到端即时播报,将特定任务的时间步抽样与分布式监督相结合.
这样可以进行简单而高效的培训和推论,并作出优越的概率预测,而不会失去压缩或确定前科。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • End-to-end training: JWS is trained directly on sensor data without separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting stages, simplifying training and inference. • Nowcasting-centric recipe: Masked Asynchronous Diffusion aligns conditioning observed during training and inference while preserving test-time flexibility. • Simple distributional objective: simple Distributional Diffusion Models are trained with a hyperparameter-free objective, improving forecasting and enabling few-step sampling. • Efficient nowcasting: Taken together, these components enable even our smallest model to achieve competitive nowcasting with approximately 17 × 17\times fewer parameters than FlowCast and substantially lower inference cost than prior methods.
blocks.zh: • 端到端培训: JWS直接接受传感器数据培训,没有经过单独培训的压缩或确定预测阶段,简化了培训和推论. • 以播音为中心的配方: 伪装同步 在培训和推论期间观察到的散射坐标调节,同时保持试验时间的灵活性。 二. 支助 简单的分布目标: 简单的分布分散模型以超参数无目标来训练,改进预测并使得能进行几步取样. • 高效的即时广播: 综合起来,这些组件甚至使我们最小的模型能够实现竞争性现货,其参数比FlowCast少了大约17×17次,推论成本也比以前的方法低得多。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: An extended Related Work section is found in Appendix Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 附录D载有扩展的相关工作部分。

blocks.en:
Nowcasting refers to short-term, high-resolution forecasting.
As rapid updates are typically required, numerical weather prediction systems (NWP) are unsuitable for precipitation nowcasting ( Shi et al., 2015 ; Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Ravuri et al., 2021 ) .
Machine learning offers faster inference ( Shi et al., 2015 ; Agrawal et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2017 ; Gao et al., 2022b ) .
Yet, training with regression objectives yields blurry forecasts under uncertainty, thus the field shifted towards generative nowcasting methods ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) .
Initially, generative adversarial networks were used ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ; Ravuri et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Ji et al., 2022 ) , yet adversarial training can induce mode collapse ( Kossale et al., 2022 ) . Therefore, diffusion-based nowcasting has become popular due to strong mode coverage and a principled mathematical foundation ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) .
To reduce denoising complexity, two-stage latent diffusion methods are commonly used ( Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Ribeiro & Pucer, 2026 ; Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) or generation is conditioned on deterministic priors ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
Yet, FREUD ( Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) finds these priors reduce distributional coverage, and inherently lossy compression induces additional uncertainty.
They ensemble generative reconstructions, introducing computational overhead and maintaining separately trained stages. Alet et al. (2025) propose to directly supervise ensembles and predict multiple forecasts by perturbing parameters through noise injection. Yet, all stochasticity must be captured by the noise vector, thereby potentially limiting coverage.
We instead propose to train end-to-end radar-space nowcasting, eliminating compression stages completely while retaining diffusion model coverage.
blocks.zh:
Nowcasting指短期高分辨预报.
由于通常需要快速更新,数值天气预报系统不适合现在的降水(Shi等人,2015年;Leinonen等人,2023年;Ravuri等人,2021年)。
机器学习提供更快的推论(Shi等,2015;Agrawal等,2019;Wang等,2017;Gao等,2022b.).
然而,关于回归目标的培训在不确定的情况下产生模糊的预测,因此,该领域转向了遗传性即时播报方法(Ravuri等,2021;Zhang等,2023;Leinonen等,2023;Gao等,2023)。
最初使用基因对抗网络(Goodfellow等,2014年;Ravuri等,2021年;张等,2023年;Ji等,2022年),然而对抗训练可以诱发模式崩溃(Kossale等,2022年). 因此,基于传播的即时播报由于模式覆盖范围强和有原则的数学基础而流行(Ho等,2020;Dhariwal & Nichol,2021;Lipman等,2023).
为了减少去诺化的复杂性,通常采用两级潜在扩散方法(Leinonen等,2023;Gao等,2023;Gong等,2024;Ribeiro和Pucer等,2026;Shusterbauer等,2026b)或代代以确定前科为条件(Yu等,2024;Gong等,2024;Zhu等,2026)。
然而,FREUD(Shusterbauer等,2026b.)发现这些前科减少了分布范围,固有的损失压缩会导致更多的不确定性.
它们共同进行基因重建,引入计算管理费,并保持经过单独培训的阶段。 阿莱特等. (2025)提议直接监督综艺节目,并通过噪声注入来扰动参数来预测多种预测. 然而,所有的花纹都必须被噪声矢量所捕捉,从而可能限制覆盖范围.
我们建议训练端到端的雷达空间即时播报,完全取消压缩阶段,同时保留扩散模型覆盖。

blocks.en:
Latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) enables high-resolution image ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and video ( Ho et al., 2022 ) generation.
Perceptual ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and adversarial ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) losses typically encourage losing mostly imperceptible details.
However, the importance of small-scale variations in nowcasting limits applicability.
Previously, architecture adaptations for pixel-space generation were explored ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Crowson et al., 2024 ) .
Recently, Li & He (2025) showed that standard transformers are indeed suitable.
However, pixel-space nowcasting is especially challenging due to high data dimensionality.
While RainDiff ( Nguyen et al., 2025b ) and PixelFlowCast ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) perform pixel-space nowcasting, they rely on specialized architectures or only model residuals of deterministic forecasts.
In comparison, we use standard transformers for end-to-end precipitation nowcasting.
blocks.zh:
Latet spission (Rombach等, 2022年) 使高分辨率图像(Esser等, 2024年)和视频(Ho等, 2022年)生成成为可能.
认知损失(Zhang等,2018年)和对抗性损失(Goodfellow等,2014年)通常会鼓励损失大多是难以理解的细节。
然而,在现货的可适用性方面,小规模变化的重要性是有限的。
以前曾探索过像素-空间生成的建筑改造(Hoogeboom等,2023;Yu等,2025;Crowson等,2024).
最近,Li & He(2025)显示标准变压器确实合适.
然而,由于数据维度高,像素-空间即时播报尤其具有挑战性.
虽然RainDiff(Nguyen等,2025b)和PixelFlowCast(Zhu等,2026年)进行像素-空间即时播报,但它们依赖于专业建筑或只使用定型预测的模型后遗症.
相比之下,我们使用标准变压器进行端到端的降水即时播报.

blocks.en:
Iterative denoising remains a bottleneck of diffusion.
Distillation ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Sauer et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024b ) drastically reduces latency, but requires two-stage training.
Flow Maps ( Boffi et al., 2025a ) directly integrate larger steps.
However, prominent MeanFlows ( Geng et al., 2025 ) induce substantial training overhead, while Shortcut models ( Frans et al., 2025 ) invest compute to produce self-bootstrapped targets.
Alternatively, Distributional Diffusion Models (DDM) ( De Bortoli et al., 2025 ) train denoising models with ensembles and scoring rule supervision, enabling few-step inference.
Moreover, distributional supervision aligns with probabilistic forecasting ( Alet et al., 2025 ) .
To scale DDM training, improved Distributional Diffusion Models (iDDM) ( Martorella et al., 2026 ) expand the ensemble only for final layers. Yet, their loss relies on tuning interdependent parameters.
We replace iDDM’s tuned parameter schedules with a simple interpolation between CRPS and squared error, achieving better nowcasting results without additional loss hyperparameters.
blocks.zh:
主动去名仍然是扩散的瓶颈。
蒸发(Salimans & Ho, 2022;Sauer等人, 2023;Song等人, 2023) 2023; Yin等, 2024b.)大幅减少了延迟,但需要两级训练.
Flow Maps (Boffi等,2025a.)直接整合了更大的步骤.
然而,突出的MeanFlows(Geng等,2025年)诱发大量培训间接费用,而快捷模式(Frans等,2025年)则投资计算以产生自我启动的目标。
或者,分布式扩散模型(DDM)(De Bortoli等,2025年)将模型脱口而出,并配有综艺和评分规则监督,从而能够进行几步推论。
此外,分布监督与概率预测相吻合(Alet等人,2025年)。
为了扩大DDM培训,改进了分布式分泌模型(iDDM)(Martorella等,2026年)只为最终层扩展了综艺. 然而,它们的损失依赖于调整相互依存的参数。
我们用CRPS和平方误差之间的简单的插值来取代 iDDM 调制参数表, 在不增加损失超参数的情况下实现更好的现成结果。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Given C C radar observations 𝐱 1 : C \mathbf{x}^{1:C} , with 𝐱 t ∈ ℝ H × W \mathbf{x}^{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} at time t t , the goal of probabilistic precipitation nowcasting is to model the distribution p ( 𝐱 C + 1 : C + L ∣ 𝐱 1 : C ) p(\mathbf{x}^{C+1:C+L}\mid\mathbf{x}^{1:C}) of the next L L precipitation frames. At inference, we sample multiple sequences to form a forecast ensemble, keeping the observed past fixed.

blocks.en:
Diffusion models learn to transform samples from a simple prior distribution into samples from the data distribution through denoising ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Albergo et al., 2023 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) . While our method works with standard transformers, patch size imposes a trade-off between spatial detail and computational cost. Hierarchical models address this trade-off by preserving high-resolution features while moving expensive processing to lower resolutions.
We therefore use an HDiT-style ( Crowson et al., 2024 ) backbone ( Fig. 4 ), with spatial attention in high-resolution layers and factorized spatiotemporal attention only in the lower-resolution bottleneck after an additional downsampling step.

We aim to build a simplified distributional objective that does not require λ \lambda and β \beta schedule tuning. Further, radar-space prediction enables the direct use of CRPS, the proper scoring rule for scalar predictive distributions commonly used in evaluation of probabilistic forecasting methods.
We therefore linearly interpolate two fixed losses: ℒ simple ​ ( τ t ) = ( 1 − τ t ) ​ CRPS + τ t ​ MSE . \boxed{\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{simple}}(\tau^{t})=(1-\tau^{t})\,\mathrm{CRPS}+\tau^{t}\,\mathrm{MSE}.} (7) CRPS supervises scalar conditional marginals at each pixel, while particlewise MSE favors conditional means.

Standard flow matching can be viewed as single-particle training: each noisy input produces one prediction. Computing the interaction term requires M ≥ 2 M\geq 2 predictions for the same input. Following iDDM ( Martorella et al., 2026 ) , we avoid repeating the full network computation by sharing early transformer layer computations, then making M M copies. To construct the particles, we concatenate independent auxiliary noise ξ i \xi_{i} to each copy along the token feature dimension, after modulating the noise with a learned τ \tau -dependent gate. The remaining transformer layers process each particle separately.
At inference, we use standard Euler sampling and keep context frames fixed throughout the denoising process.

Our training paradigm enables conditioning on deterministic forecasts, similar to CasCast ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , but without requiring such priors during training.
Following Schusterbauer et al. (2026b) , we initialize denoising from noised EarthFormer ( Gao et al., 2022b ) predictions.
Hereby, the noising timestep τ \tau controls the strength of the deterministic prior: larger τ \tau preserves more of the forecast, while smaller τ \tau replaces it increasingly with noise and thus gives the generative model more freedom to deviate from it.
As shown in Fig. 9 , weak deterministic priors improve CSI and HSS up to τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 , but any deterministic conditioning consistently deteriorates calibration.

Using small JWS models, Fig. 21 shows that cleaner priors for early frames and noisier priors for later frames improve CRPS, reliability, and CSI compared to uniform prior strength.
The RaMViD baseline, which does not support such framewise confidence, underperforms particularly in calibration.

Moreover, JWS substantially improves over the deterministic EarthFormer prior, demonstrating the benefit of generative refinement for long-horizon forecasting.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Precipitation nowcasting requires rapid updates and calibrated uncertainty.
We present JWS, a simple end-to-end generative nowcasting method. JWS does not rely on compression models. Thus, ensembling quantifies uncertainty directly in radar-space. Training with a distributional objective unlocks few-step sampling at inference time, drastically reducing latency.
Our approach achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic nowcasting performance on the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks.
Our approach is scalable with respect to the model size and the available computational budget at inference time, while efficient settings perform competitively.
By greatly simplifying training and inference, we hope that JWS can be easily adopted by meteorological practitioners.

我们的方法实现了SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上的最新概率。
在模型大小和推断时间可用的计算预算方面,我们的方法是可扩展的,而高效的设置则是竞争性的。
通过大大简化培训和推论,我们希望JWS能够容易地被气象从业人员采用.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 JWS training step

blocks.en:
We build JWS using standard Llama-style Transformers. Model variants across scales differ only in the number of layers and their hidden dimensionality, resulting in four model sizes ranging from 9M to 340M parameters.
All hierarchical models use an initial patchification of 1 × 16 × 16 1\times 16\times 16 matching Li & He (2025) . We follow Schusterbauer et al. (2026b) and use neighborhood attention ( Hassani et al., 2023 ) for the high-resolution transformer layers, restricting attention to a 5 × 5 5\times 5 region within each frame. All models use two high resolution layers before down- and two layers after upsampling (four in total). The remaining layers are applied after additional 1 × 2 × 2 1\times 2\times 2 patchification ( 1 × 32 × 32 1\times 32\times 32 in total). Bottleneck layers attend to the full spatiotemporal grid but use interleaved factorized attention, interleaving only-spatial and only-temporal attention blocks.
All models use Adaptive RMSNorm ( Zhang & Sennrich, 2019 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Xu et al., 2019 ) for normalization and diffusion-time conditioning. Further, all models use SwiGLU ( Shazeer, 2020 ) activations and 3D Axial Rotary Positional Embeddings ( Su et al., 2023 ; Heo et al., 2024 ) .

所有分级模型都使用1×16×16 1\times 16相匹配李克用(2025)的初始补丁. 我们跟随Schusterbauer等人(2026b),并在高分辨率变压器层使用邻里关注(Hassani等,2023),将注意力限制在每帧内5×5相5相5相5相5相5相. 所有模型在下行前使用两个高分辨层,在上行采样后使用两个分辨层(共4个分辨层). 其余地层在再加1×2×2×2×2×2×2×2×2×2×2×补正后被应用(总共1×32×32×1×32×32). Bottleneck地层关注全相片网格,但使用相片分分层的注意,相片相片相片相片相片只与相片相片相片相片.

We train with 25 × 384 × 384 25\times 384\times 384 sequences from the SEVIR ( Veillette et al., 2020 ) dataset ( 24 × 400 × 400 24\times 400\times 400 for MeteoNet). Figure 20: Data scaling. JWS-L overfits on reduced training data, while increased data diversity shows stable training and clearer gains from model scaling.
blocks.zh: 图20:数据缩放。 JWS-L对已减少的培训数据过度使用,而数据多样性的提高表明培训是稳定的,而且模型的扩展也取得了更明确的成果。

blocks.en:
Tabs. 5 and 6 show that JWS scales effectively with model capacity.
However, the gains diminish for JWS-L, as shown in Fig. 18 .
We attribute this saturation to the limited diversity of the training data: although exhaustive subsequence sampling yields approximately 400k training sequences, these originate from only 16k distinct SEVIR weather events ( Veillette et al., 2020 ) .
We therefore hypothesize that further scaling requires increasing training data alongside model capacity, consistent with findings on compute-optimal scaling in large language models ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) .
To test this hypothesis, we increase training data diversity through random cropping and compare training on 50% and 100% of SEVIR events.
We extract 192 2 192^{2} crops to preserve most of the spatial context and resize to 128 2 128^{2} for computational efficiency.
As shown in Fig. 20 , JWS-L exhibits substantially stronger overfitting than JWS-B when trained only on half of the available events.
In comparison, using the full augmented dataset eliminates overfitting. In this setting, JWS consistently benefits from increased model capacity. This supports our hypothesis that data availability limits model scaling.
For our main results on the full resolution data, we partially address this limitation by pretraining JWS-L at 128 2 128^{2} resolution for 100k steps, which further reduces training cost, and then finetune at full resolution.
As shown in Fig. 19 , training from scratch at full resolution steadily deteriorates validation performance, whereas pretraining followed by finetuning substantially improves performance and mitigates overfitting.
blocks.zh:

我们把这种饱和归因于培训数据的多样性有限:虽然详尽无遗的子序列取样得出了大约400克的培训序列,但这些序列仅出自16克不同的SEVIR天气事件(Veillette等,2020年)。
因此,我们假设,进一步扩大规模需要增加培训数据以及模型能力,这与大型语言模型的计算-优化规模的结论一致(Hoffmann等人,2022年)。
为了测试这个假说,我们通过随机收割来增加培训数据的多样性,并比较50%和100%的SEVIR事件的培训.
我们提取出192 2 192^{2}的作物来保存大部分的空间环境 并调整到128 2 128^{2}的计算效率。
如图20所显示的,JWS-L在只接受过一半现有活动的培训时,其比JWS-B的适应性要强得多。
相比之下,使用全面扩充的数据集消除了过度调整。 在此情况下,JWS一贯受益于模型能力的提高. 这支持我们的假设,即数据可用性限制了模型的缩放.
对于我们对于全解析数据的主要结果,我们部分地解决了这一局限性,预先训练JWS-L为128 2 128======100k步骤,这进一步降低了训练费用,然后以全解度微调.
如图19所示,完全解析后从零开始的培训使验证性能持续恶化,而前期培训后再作微调,大大提高了业绩并缓解了过度调整。

Heidke Skill Score (HSS) is computed on a per-pixel basis to identify positional accuracy. Using a user-defined threshold, true positives (TP), false positives (FP), false negatives (FN), and true negatives (TN) are first calculated based on binarized ground truth and forecasted precipitation. Then HSS is computed as H ​ S ​ S = 2 ​ ( T ​ P ⋅ T ​ N − F ​ P ⋅ F ​ N ) ( T ​ P + F ​ N ) ​ ( F ​ N + T ​ N ) + ( T ​ P + F ​ P ) ​ ( F ​ P + T ​ N ) . HSS=\frac{2(TP\cdot TN-FP\cdot FN)}{(TP+FN)(FN+TN)+(TP+FP)(FP+TN)}. (8) Following prior work we average HSS over six thresholds (16, 74, 133, 160, 181, 219) to obtain the final value.
Intuitively, HSS indicates improvement over random chance, where 0 indicates no improvement and 1 corresponds to perfect prediction.

HSS=\frac{2(TP\cdot TN-FP\cdot FN)}(TP+FN)(FN+TN)+(TP+FP (FP+TN))}. (8) 继先前的工作之后,我们的平均最高安全标准超过六个阈值(16、74、133、160、181、219),以获得最终价值。
直觉上,HSS表示比随机机会有改进,0表示没有改进,而1表示与完美预测相对应.

The Critical Success Index (CSI) or Threat Score quantifies the proportion of correctly predicted events excluding true negatives. Therefore, it remains useful when non-events dominate the data as in precipitation forecasting.
After the same binarization as for HSS, CSI is given by C ​ S ​ I = T ​ P T ​ P + F ​ P + F ​ N . CSI=\frac{TP}{TP+FP+FN}. (9) The reported CSI is averaged over the same thresholds as HSS.

blocks.en: C.3 Datasets
blocks.zh: C.3 数据集

blocks.en:
Our main evaluations are carried out using the SEVIR ( Veillette et al., 2020 ) dataset.
SEVIR contains 20,393 weather events of which 20% correspond to known extreme weather events from the NOAA Storm Event Database ( NOAA / National Centers For Environmental Information, 2020 ) . The remaining 80% were randomly chosen while oversampling high precipitation.
SEVIR is collected from 2017–2019 over the continental United States region. Each sample covers a 384 ​ km × 384 ​ km 384\,\text{km}\times 384\,\text{km} area for 4 h with 1 km spatial and 5 min temporal resolution.
Precipitation is indicated by the NEXRAD Vertically Integrated Liquid product (VIL).
blocks.zh:
我们的主要评估是使用SEVIR(Veillette等,2020年)数据集进行的。
SEVIR包含20,393起天气事件,其中20%对应来自NOAA风暴事件数据库(NOAA / National Centre for Environment Information, 2020.)的已知极端天气事件. 其余80%是随机选择的,同时对高降水量进行过度抽样。
SEVIR采集于2017–2019年美国大陆地区. 每个样本覆盖了384 km×384 km 384\,\text{km}times 384\,\text{km}面积4 h,空间分辨率为1 km,时间分辨率为5分.
NEXRAD垂直集成液体产品(VIL)表示降水.

blocks.en:
We use the train-test split provided by Gong et al. (2024) and follow Schusterbauer et al. (2026b) in joining the validation set into training and sampling exhaustive subsequences to increase training data size. Following prior work, we use 65 min (13 frames) conditioning to predict 60 min (12 frames) future precipitation unless noted otherwise.
We follow the standard preprocessing ( Veillette et al., 2020 ) and keep non-linear VIL encoding to [ 0,255 ] [0,255] which we normalize further to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] for training following Schusterbauer et al. (2026b) .
To ensure comparability ( Gong et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2022b ; She et al., 2024 ; Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ; Ribeiro & Pucer, 2026 ) , we use H = W = 384 H=W=384 , C = 13 C=13 , L = 12 L=12 , and T = C + L = 25 T=C+L=25 unless specified otherwise.

为确保可比性(龚等,2024;高等,2022b;谢等,2024;舒斯特鲍尔等,2026b;里贝罗与普塞尔,2026),我们使用H=W=384H=W=384;C=13C=13;L=12L=12;T=C+L=25T=C+L=25,除非另有说明.

blocks.en:
The MeteoNet benchmark ( Larvor et al., 2020 ) includes observations over fixed regions in northwestern and southeastern France from 2016–2018. Radar measurements are provided in 5 min intervals with ≈ 1 ​ km 2 \approx 1\,\text{km}^{2} resolution.
Following Gong et al. (2024) , we use the old radar reflectivity product and extract the top-left 400 × 400 400\times 400 grid cells of the southeastern region.
Again, we combine training and validation periods and exhaustively sample subsequences for training, while testing on the same data as prior work ( Gong et al., 2024 ; Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) .
Following Gong et al. (2024) we use 24-frame subsequences and predict the next 12 frames given a 12-frame context. We normalize the reflectivity values from [ 0 , 70 ] [0,70] to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] for training. To enable using the same JWS architecture as for SEVIR, we bilinearly resize to 384 × 384 384\times 384 for model processing, but keep metric computation at the native resolution.
To compute HSS and CSI we use thresholds of [ 19 , 25 , 35 , 40 , 47 ] [19,25,35,40,47] dBZ ( Gong et al., 2024 ) .
Appendix D Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: We expand on the related works presented in Sec. 2 to provide additional context on existing methods and our advances upon these.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步阐述第2节中提出的相关工作,以提供更多关于现有方法和我们在这方面所取得进展的背景。

blocks.en: D.1 Machine Learning for Nowcasting
blocks.zh: D.1 新播机学习

blocks.en:
Weather nowcasting refers to short-term, high-resolution forecasting over lead times ranging from one to twelve hours. Typically nowcasting operates on ≤ 5 \leq 5 km spatial grids with ≤ 10 \leq 10 min temporal resolution. Physics-based numerical weather prediction is computationally expensive, and therefore not well-suited for applications that require rapid updates ( Shi et al., 2015 ; Shi et al., 2017 ; Sønderby et al., 2020 ; Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Ravuri et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) .
Early research used optical flow based forecasts ( Woo & Wong, 2017 ; Cheung & Yeung, 2012 ; Germann & Zawadzki, 2002 ; Sakaino, 2013 ) for rapid-update tasks, however these approaches cannot model rain onset or dissipation ( Hur & Roth, 2019 ; Shi et al., 2015 ) .
Therefore, machine learning methods based on convolutional neural networks ( Shi et al., 2015 ; Agrawal et al., 2019 ) , recurrent neural networks ( Wang et al., 2017 ) , or transformers ( Gao et al., 2022a ; Gao et al., 2022b ) have been developed. These approaches use patterns in observed past context to regress future weather states.
While machine learning methods also begin to dominate medium- and long-range forecasting ( Sønderby et al., 2020 ; Espeholt et al., 2022 ; Pathak et al., 2022 ; Price et al., 2024 ; Alet et al., 2025 ) , they are especially important in nowcasting due to their significantly reduced inference time.
blocks.zh:
天气即时预报是指在一至十二小时的周期内进行短期高分辨率预报. 典型的即时播报运行在5相克5千米的空间网格上,时间分辨率为10相克10分. 基于物理的数值天气预测在计算上昂贵,因此不适合需要快速更新的应用(Shi等,2015;Shi等,2017;Sønderby等,2020;Leonen等,2023;Ravuri等,2021;Chen等,2023).
早期的研究利用了基于光学流的预测(Woo & Wong,2017;Cheang & Yeung,2012;Germann & Zawadzki,2002;Sakaino,2013.)来完成快速更新的任务,但这些方法不能模拟起雨或消散(Hur & Roth,2019;Shi等,2015.).
因此,基于革命神经网络的机器学习方法(Shi等,2015;Agrawal等,2019),反复出现的神经网络(Wang等,2017),或变压器. (Gao等人,2022a;Gao等人,2022b)已经开发。 这些办法利用过去观察到的情况来倒退未来的天气状况。
虽然机器学习方法也开始主导中长程预报(Sønderby等,2020年;Espeholt等,2022年;Pathak等,2022年;Price等,2024年;Alet等,2025年),但由于推断时间明显缩短,这些方法在现成预测中尤为重要.

blocks.en:
However, weather dynamics are inherently chaotic and unpredictable ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ) requiring probabilistic forecasting under partially observable initial conditions.
Yet, deterministic regression models lack robust uncertainty quantification and average possibilities leading to increasingly blurry forecasts over lead time. Alet et al. (2025) proposed Functional Generative Networks (FGNs) for medium-range forecasting, training a deterministic model to predict an ensemble of forecasts directly by optimizing an ensemble scoring function. However, they restrict the variability of forecasts to be encoded in a low-dimensional noise vector. Local variability in nowcasting is typically higher than variance in medium-range forecasting limiting the applicability of this approach compared to diffusion models due to reduced distributional coverage. Therefore, FGNs still become increasingly blurry in our experiments (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh:
然而,天气动态本质上是混乱和无法预测的(Ravuri等,2021年),需要在部分可观测的初步条件下进行概率预测.
然而,确定性回归模型缺乏可靠的不确定性量化和平均可能性,导致预测在准备期间越来越模糊。 阿莱特等. (2025)提议功能基因网(FGNs)用于中程预报,培训一个定型模型来通过优化综艺分数函数来直接预测一组预测. 然而,它们限制了预测的可变性被编码为低维噪声矢量. 与传播模型相比,由于分布范围缩小,当地在播报方面的可变性通常高于中程预测方面的可变性,从而限制了这种方法的适用性。 因此,在我们的实验中,FGNs仍然变得越来越模糊(附录E.2.).

blocks.en:
Therefore, researchers employed generative adversarial ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu & Lee, 2020 ) and generative diffusion ( Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Ribeiro & Pucer, 2026 ) methods, trained to produce a sample from the conditional distribution of predictions rather than to regress the mean. As adversarial approaches are prone to mode collapse ( Kossale et al., 2022 ) and, thus, fail to capture the full posterior distribution, diffusion-based nowcasting has become the de facto standard approach.
Early diffusion-based precipitation nowcasting approaches sampled future evolution based only on prior observations ( Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) . However, later papers argued conditioning the model on a deterministic forecast ( Gong et al., 2024 ) or sampling only the residual between a deterministic forecast and the ground truth ( Yu et al., 2024 ) enables superior forecasting.
Similarly, Park et al. (2026a) build upon the deterministic exPreCast model ( Song et al., 2026 ) by using a diffusion model to model only small scale variability and enable ensembling of stochastic elements.
However, FREUD ( Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) argues conditioning on a deterministic forecast biases the generation and thus limits uncertainty quantification. Compounding evidence by Ribeiro & Pucer (2026) supports the claim that training a sufficiently capable diffusion model suffices for accurate forecasting and superior calibration.
blocks.zh:
因此,研究人员采用了基因对抗法。 (Ravuri等,2021;Zhang等,2023;Liu & Lee,2020)和基因传播(Leinonen等,2023;Gao等,2023;Ribeiro & Pucer等,2026)方法,经过培训,从有条件的预测分布中生成样本,而不会倒退平均值. 由于对抗性方法容易发生模式崩溃(Kossale等,2022年),因此无法捕捉到全部后发,以扩散为基础的即时播报已成为事实上的标准方法.
早期以扩散为基础的降水即时播报方法仅根据先前的观测结果对今后的演化情况进行了抽样(Leinonen等人,2023;Gao等人,2023)。 然而,后来的论文认为,以确定性预报(Gong等,2024年)作为模型的条件,或者只取样确定性预报和地面真相之间的剩余部分(Yu等,2024年),从而能够作出更好的预测。
同样地,Park等人(2026年a)利用确定性前PreCast模型(Song等人,2026年),利用扩散模型只模拟小尺度可变性,并能够对花样元素进行聚合.
然而,FREUD(Shusterbauer等人,2026年b)认为,以决定性的预测为条件,对产生者有偏见,从而限制了不确定性的量化。 Ribeiro & Pucer的复合证据(2026年)支持这一说法,即训练一个足够能的传播模型就足以进行准确的预测和更好的校正。

blocks.en:
An additional downside is that most diffusion-based nowcasting methods ( Leinonen et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Ribeiro & Pucer, 2026 ; Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) operate in a compressed latent space to enable faster sampling. However, compression is inherently lossy and thus induces additional uncertainty about reconstructions. Schusterbauer et al. (2026b) propose to quantify this uncertainty using generative reconstructions. However, this means for each latent ensemble member a full ensemble of reconstructions has to be constructed to quantify all uncertainty, inducing a significant computational overhead.
Some previous works instead tackle pixel-space nowcasting using specialized architectures ( Nguyen et al., 2025b ) or by only modeling residuals from a deterministic forecast ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) which still requires a two-stage design and biases forecasts.
In comparison, JWS enables pixel space nowcasting with a standard, scalable architecture and with a single end-to-end model, simplifying training and inference.
blocks.zh:
另一个缺点是,大多数以扩散为基础的现成方法(Leinonen等人,2023年;Gao等人,2023年;Gong等人,2024年;Ribeiro & Puser,2026年;Shusterbauer等人,2026年b)在压缩后的潜在空间运作,以便能够更快地取样。 然而,压缩本身是损失的,因此会给重建带来更多的不确定性. Schusterbauer等人(2026年b)提议利用基因重建来量化这种不确定性. 然而,这意味着每个潜在的成员必须建立完整的重建组合,以量化所有不确定性,从而带来重大的计算间接费用。
先前的一些作品则利用专业建筑处理像素-空间即时播报(Nguyen等,2025b),或仅从确定性的预测(Yu等,2024;Zhu等,2026)中模拟残片,这仍然需要两个阶段的设计和偏差预测。
相较之下,JWS使得像素空间现在可以以标准,可扩展的架构和单一的端到端模型来进行播映,简化了培训和推论.

blocks.en: D.2 Pixel-space Diffusion
blocks.zh: D.2 像素空间扩散

blocks.en:
Initial works in diffusion-based image generation applied iterative denoising in pixel-space ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) . Yet, computational costs made these models difficult to scale and deploy.
Latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) proposed to first compress perceptual information into a low-dimensional latent and then apply the diffusion process only in this compact latent space. This enabled high-resolution image generation on consumer hardware and training video generation models with academic resources ( He et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
基于扩散的图像生成的初步作品应用了像素-空间的迭代去诺(Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021; Ho等, 2020.). 然而,计算费用使这些模型难以进行规模调整和部署。
Lententnt spission(Rombach等人,2022年)提议首先将知觉信息压缩为低维潜能,然后只在这种紧凑潜能空间中应用扩散过程. 这使得能够用学术资源制作高分辨率的消费硬件图像和培训视频生成模型(He等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: However, the complexity of training multiple stages motivated the authors of simple diffusion ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ) to develop an architecture for direct pixel-space diffusion modeling by adapting the noise schedule and downsampling early in the UNet ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) backbone to concentrate capacity in the bottleneck. Further improvements ( Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ) identify reducing skip connections as a pathway to further enhance scalability. Through this modification, improved loss weighting, and preferring scaling the number of processed patches over increasing the model capacity they achieve strong pixel-space generation performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,培训多个阶段的复杂性促使简单扩散的作者(Hoogeboom等,2023年)通过在UNet(Ronneberger等,2015年)早期调整噪音表和下采样,开发出直接像素-空间扩散模型的架构来将能力集中在瓶颈. 进一步改进(Hoogeboom等,2025年)确定减少跳过连接是进一步提高可扩展性的途径。 通过这种修改,改进了损失权重,更倾向于扩大已处理补丁的数量,而不是增加它们实现强像素-空间生成性能的模型能力.

blocks.en: Alternatives like PixelFlow ( Chen et al., 2025 ) propose to modify the denoising process itself to enable pixel-space modeling. Chen et al. (2025) propose to schedule the image resolution over the denoising trajectory, progressively moving from noisy low resolution images to clean high resolution images during sampling. Thus, their approach saves compute on high-frequency details while these are masked by noise. Wang et al. (2025) , on the other hand, enable high-resolution image synthesis by predicting patch-specific neural-field weights, with the resulting fields mapping noisy pixel values and spatial coordinates to pixel-wise velocities. This concentrates expensive transformer computation on low-resolution patches while using lightweight neural fields for pixel-level prediction, avoiding the cost of processing each pixel as a separate transformer token.
blocks.zh: PixelFlow等替代品(Chen等,2025年)提议自行修改去诺化过程来使像素-空间模型化. 陈等. (2025年)提议将图像分辨率排在去诺氏轨迹上,从吵闹的低分辨率图像逐步转移到采样时清理高分辨率图像. 因此,它们的方法节省了高频细节的计算,而噪声掩盖了这些细节。 而Wang等 (2025)则通过预测补丁特有神经-场重来进行高分辨的图像合成,并由此得到的字段将吵闹的像素值和空间坐标映射到像素-顺理成正率. 这集中了昂贵的变压器在低分辨率补丁上进行计算,同时将轻量级神经场用于像素水平的预测,避免了作为单独的变压器符号处理每个像素的成本.

blocks.en:
Alternatively, both PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and DiP ( Chen et al., 2026 ) propose combining a large transformer for global structure with local refinement modules to enable pixel-space high resolution image generation.
Other alternative architectures such as RIN ( Jabri et al., 2023 ) and FIT ( Chen & Li, 2023 ) enable high-resolution pixel-space modeling by reducing computational complexity of expensive self-attention. RIN ( Jabri et al., 2023 ) concentrates computation on a compact set of latent tokens that exchange information with pixel-space data tokens through cross-attention, reusing latent representations across denoising steps. Chen & Li (2023) propose interleaving local attention within groups of data tokens with global attention over a smaller subset of tokens.
blocks.zh:
或者,双像素DIT (Yu等,2025年)和DiP(Chen等,2026年)提出将全球结构的大变压器与局部精细模块相融合,使像素-空间高分辨率图像生成成为可能.
其他替代架构如RIN(Jabri等,2023年)和FIT(Chen & Li,2023年)通过降低昂贵自留的计算复杂性来进行高分辨率像素-空间模型. RIN(Jabri等人,2023年)集中计算一套紧凑的暗指使,这些暗指使通过交叉注意与像素-空间数据暗指来交换信息,并重新使用暗指使跨越去诺步骤. Chen & Li(2023年)提议将本地注意力放在数据符号组中,

blocks.en:
However, Li & He (2025) show that standard Vision Transformer architectures ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) with a large patch size are capable of accurate pixel-space generation when adjusting timestep sampling during training and predicting clean visual information. They argue that under the manifold assumption clean data has lower intrinsic dimensionality than noise or noise-containing velocities, thus making clean data easier to compress by patchification.
Similarly, HDiT ( Crowson et al., 2024 ) presents a hierarchical transformer architecture that substantially reduces computational requirements in pixel-space modeling while maintaining the strong scalability of vision transformers.
However, due to the additional temporal dimension, pixel-space generation of video or weather forecasting data is especially challenging and computationally demanding ( Jabri et al., 2023 ) .
Closest to our work, FREUD ( Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) uses a pixel-space HDiT to reconstruct precipitation fields from compressed latents. They show that a generative decoder modeling the full video sequence increases temporal consistency. However, the FREUD decoder receives strong framewise conditioning information and therefore operates efficiently with low model capacity and few-step inference.
Instead, JWS learns end-to-end weather nowcasting directly in pixel-space. We use standard transformer architectures and denoising procedures, maintaining scalability and simplicity.
blocks.zh:
然而,Li & He(2025年)显示,标准Vision Transformer架构(Dosovitskiy等,2020; Peebles & Xie,2023年)有大补丁尺寸,在培训和预测清洁视觉信息时,在调整时序采样时能够精确地生成像素-空间. 他们认为,在多重假设下,清洁数据的内在维度低于噪音或含噪声的速度,从而使清洁数据更容易被补丁压缩.
同样,HDIT (Crowson等,2024年)呈现出分级变压器架构,在像素-空间建模中大大减少了计算要求,同时保持了视觉变压器的强烈可伸缩性.
然而,由于时间维度增加,像素-空间生成视频或天气预报数据尤其具有挑战性和计算要求(Jabri等人,2023年)。
与我们的工作最接近的是,FREUD(Shusterbauer等,2026年b)使用像素-空间的HDIT来从被压缩的潜伏地重建降水场. 它们显示,一个基因解码器模型,用于完整视频序列会增加时间一致性. 然而,FREUD解码器接收了强大的框架调节信息,因此以较低的模型容量和少步推论高效运行.
取而代之的是,JWS在像素-空间中直接学习到端到端的天气现在. 我们使用标准变压器架构和去名程序,保持可伸缩性和简洁性.

blocks.en: D.3 Few-Step Sampling
blocks.zh: D.3 几个阶段抽样

blocks.en:
Precipitation nowcasting requires rapid updates ( Shi et al., 2015 ; Ravuri et al., 2021 ) , which is at odds with the iterative nature of generative diffusion and flow models that tend to improve with more function evaluations.
Reducing computational complexity and latency by reducing the number of sampling steps required to produce high-quality samples has been a focus of many researchers in recent years.
Most prominently, researchers proposed methods to reduce the number of inference steps by modifying the denoising trajectory.
DDIM ( Song et al., 2020 ) defines an ODE path for trained diffusion models that can be traversed with larger steps. While Flow Matching methods ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) explicitly define a straighter trajectory during training, which allows faster traversal ( Liu et al., 2022 ) .
However, these methods typically still require about 20 network evaluations to produce high-quality samples.
blocks.zh:
现在的降水需要快速更新 (Shi等,2015;Ravuri等,2021),这与基因传播和流动模型的迭接性质相悖,这些模型往往随着功能评价的增加而得到改进.
通过减少生产高质量样品所需的采样步骤数量来减少计算的复杂性和耐用性,是近年来许多研究人员的工作重点.
最显著的是,研究人员提出了通过改变去诺氏轨迹来减少推论步骤数量的方法.
DDIM (Song et al., 2020) 定义了训练有素的传播模型的ODE路径,可以通过更大的步骤来穿行. 虽然流相匹配方法(Lipman等,2023年)在训练中明确定义了更直的轨迹,这允许更快地穿行(Liu等,2022年).
然而,这些方法通常仍需要大约20个网络评价才能产生高质量的样本。

blocks.en:
Few-step distillation approaches first train a default diffusion model and then distill the model’s output into a few-step generative model using progressive MSE-based distillation ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ) , adversarial objectives ( Sauer et al., 2023 ) , consistency objectives ( Song et al., 2023 ) , or distribution matching objectives ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) .
However, distillation introduces additional training complexity by requiring a two-stage process. Additionally, previous research shows distillation often reduces the diversity of samples ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Gandikota & Bau, 2025 ) , limiting applicability in domains where capturing the full distribution of potential outcomes is essential.
blocks.zh:
少步蒸馏法首先训练出默认扩散模型,再将模型的输出分出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 Yin等, 2024a) (中文(中国大陆) ).
然而,蒸馏需要分两个阶段进行,从而增加了培训的复杂性。 此外,以前的研究表明蒸馏往往会减少样品的多样性(Yin等,2024a;Gandikota和Bau,2025),限制了在捕捉潜在结果的充分分布至关重要的领域的适用性。

blocks.en:
Consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) can be used for distillation as well as for training from scratch.
Their training objective puts them in the family of Flow Map models ( Boffi et al., 2025a ) which are trained to directly integrate the denoising trajectory between two diffusion timesteps.
Flow maps can be grouped into three categories following Boffi et al. (2025b) : First, Eulerian Flow Maps enforce that a change in the starting point should not change the outcome at the destination time. Second, progressive Flow Maps train models s.t. one large jump agrees with the composition of two smaller jumps. Finally, Lagrangian Flow Maps enforce that a change in the destination time corresponds to following the velocity field at the original destination.
blocks.zh:
一致性模型 (Song等,2023)可用于蒸馏和从零开始的训练.
他们的培训目标是将他们纳入流动地图模型(Boffi等人,2025年a)的大家庭,这些模型经过培训,可直接将两个传播时间步之间的去名轨迹相融合。
流程图可分为以下三类: 首先,欧莱安流 地图显示,起点的改变不应改变目的地时间的结果。 第二,进步流图列车型号s.t. 1个大跳跃与两个更小跳跃的构成一致. 最后,拉格朗日流图强制规定,目的地时间的改变相当于跟随原目的地的速度场.

blocks.en:
MeanFlows ( Geng et al., 2025 ) are the most prominent example of Eulerian Flow Maps, yet require an expensive Jacobian-vector product (JVP) operation to obtain the training target. While improved MeanFlows ( Geng et al., 2026 ) stabilizes the training objective and PixelMeanFlow ( Lu et al., 2026 ) combines improved MeanFlow with JiT ( Li & He, 2025 ) , they retain the expensive JVP computation.
In comparison, SplitMeanFlow ( Guo et al., 2025 ) eliminates the JVP computation and resembles Shortcut model ( Frans et al., 2025 ) training. These methods fall in the category of progressive Flow Maps. Yet, they require multiple network evaluations during training to obtain self-bootstrapped targets, instead of training for superior distributional coverage. Lagrangian Self-Distillation (LSD) ( Boffi et al., 2025b ) is an example of the final Flow Map category. These approaches still require time differentiation through the network and additional velocity evaluation at the predicted endpoint to derive their target.
Moreover, although Flow Map methods enable few-step generation, there is compounding evidence ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2025a ) that distributional coverage is sensitive to the training formulation, potentially increasing the difficulty of applying Flow Maps in domains where uncertainty is essential.
blocks.zh:
MeanFlows(Geng等,2025年)是Eulerian流图中最突出的例子,然而需要昂贵的Jacobian-vector产品(JVP)操作才能得到训练目标. 虽然改进了MeanFlows(Geng等人,2026年)稳定了培训目标,而PixelMeanFlow(Lu等人,2026年)将改进了的MeanFlow与JiT(Li & He,2025年)相结合,但他们保留了昂贵的JVP计算.
相形之下,SplitMeanFlow(Guo等,2025年)取消了JVP的计算,类似于快捷模式(Frans等,2025年)的培训. 这些方法属于累进流图类. 然而,它们要求在培训期间进行多种网络评价,以获得自我启动的目标,而不是对更好的分布范围进行培训。 拉格朗日自流图(LSD)(Boffi等,2025b.)是最终流图类的例子. 这些办法仍然需要通过网络和在预测终点的额外速度评价来区分时间,以得出目标。
此外,虽然流图方法可以少步生成,但有复合证据(Huang等人,2026年;Nguyen等人,2025年a)表明,分布范围对培训方法很敏感,有可能增加在不确定性至关重要的领域应用流图的困难。

blocks.en:
Distribution-level objectives offer a promising alternative.
Inductive Moment Matching (IMM) ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) constructs a Flow Map by learning mappings between noise levels through matching output distributions instead of individual samples with a maximum mean discrepancy objective.
Improving simplicity, Distributional Diffusion Models (DDM) ( De Bortoli et al., 2025 ) show that training a diffusion model to predict a distribution of outputs rather than the conditional mean by supervision with a proper scoring rule suffices to build strong few-step generative models. Distributional Diffusion Models are especially promising for weather forecasting applications as they directly train a generative model to produce an ensemble of outputs.
However, DDMs require multiple passes through the full network to produce an ensemble of outputs during training and do not perform well for the many-step setting.
Released only two weeks prior to our paper, Park et al. (2026b) propose a distributional diffusion model for medium-range weather forecasting with marginal CRPS supervision. However, they focus on one-step predictions and cannot scale to more NFEs, mirroring our experiments with only-CRPS supervision ( Tab. 4 ).
In contrast, improved Distributional Diffusion Models (iDDM) ( Martorella et al., 2026 ) show that using a time-dependent interpolation between distributional and MSE objectives produces a model that performs well in few and many step inference. Additionally, combined with strong conditioning on auxiliary noise, late expansion of the ensemble for only a few final layers is sufficient to train a DDM, making training scalable.
blocks.zh:
分配一级的目标提供了一个有希望的替代办法。
诱导运动相配(IMM)(周克等,2025年)通过将输出分布相配,而不是单个样本相配,以最大平均相差目标相配,在噪声水平之间学习绘图,构建出流图.
改进简便性,分布式扩散模型(DDM)(De Bortoli等,2025年)表明,培训一种传播模型来预测产出的分布,而不是以适当的分数规则进行监督的有条件平均值,足以建立强有力的几步分基因模型。 分布式扩散模型对天气预报应用特别有希望,因为它们直接训练出一种基因模型,以产生一系列产出。
然而,DDM需要多次通过整个网络,以便在培训期间产生一系列产出,而且对于许多步骤的设定来说表现不佳。
仅仅在我们论文发表前两周,Park等人(2026年b)提出了中程天气预报的分布传播模型,并有边际CRPS监督. 然而,它们侧重于单步预测,不能扩大至更多的非常规外核素,这与我们的实验相呼应,只有CRPS监督(Tab. 4).
相比之下,改进的分布式扩散模型(iDDM)(Martorella等,2026年)表明,利用分布式目标和MSE目标之间的时间依赖插值,产生了一种在少数和许多步骤推论中表现良好的模型. 此外,加上辅助噪声的强调,晚期只扩展出几层的综艺节目,足以训练DDM,使训练可扩展.

blocks.en:
PixelFlowCast ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) built a pixel-space nowcasting method with a (Pixel-)MeanFlow objective ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) . However, it only models the residual of a deterministic forecast. Further, due to the cost of MeanFlow training, their model was only trained for downsampled data.
We argue that Distributional Diffusion ( De Bortoli et al., 2025 ; Martorella et al., 2026 ) is a natural fit for weather nowcasting and makes efficient nowcasting with standard transformer architectures ( Li & He, 2025 ; Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ; Crowson et al., 2024 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) feasible without biasing generation ( Schusterbauer et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
像素花纹 Cast (Zhu等,2026年)用(Pixel-)MeanFlow目标(Lu等,2026年;Geng等,2025年)构建了像素-空间即时播映方法. 然而,它只模拟确定性预测的剩余部分。 此外,由于MeanFlow培训的费用,他们的模型只接受了下取样数据的培训。
我们争辩说,分布式散射(De Bortoli等,2025年;Martorella等,2026年)是自然适合天气现成的,能够以标准变压器结构高效现成(Li & He,2025年;Dosovitskiy等,2020年;Crowson等,2024年;Peebles等,2023年;Ma等,2024年)不带偏见的一代(Shusterbauer等,2026年b).
